title: Change your password
body: Choose a new password. You stay signed in on this device; other devices are signed out.
forcedBody: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose your own before you start.
ruleNotCurrent: Not the same as the current password

error.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: The new password is too short. Use at least 10 characters.
error.PASSWORD_TOO_LONG: The new password is too long. Use at most 72 characters.
error.PASSWORD_SAME: The new password must be different from the current one.
error.PASSWORD_HAS_USERNAME: The new password must not contain your username.
error.CURRENT_PASSWORD_WRONG: The current password is not right. Check it and try again.
error.MFA_REQUIRED: Enter the code from your authenticator app first.
error.NOT_SIGNED_IN: You are signed out. Sign in again, then change your password.
error.NOT_AUTHORIZED: This account can't change its password. Ask your manager.
error.network: The connection dropped. Check it, then tap Save again: nothing is changed twice.
error.unknown: The password could not be changed. Try again; if it keeps happening, tell your manager.
